name: Granite Roundhead
description: The cudgel is raised before the face in a salute, then lowered into a guard that covers both sides.

name: Irongirth
description: The first bench rules with a quick rap on the left side of the opponent's head or shoulder.

name: Blaze Bludgeon
description: The second bench answers at once with a knock on the opposite hip, upholding the first.

name: Cloutvortex
description: Two measured paces are traded, one forward and one aside, keeping the opponent between the benches.

name: Adamantine Handholdgrip
description: The same parry is made on both sides in turn, turning a flurry of strikes harmlessly past.

name: Mayhemknob
description: The cudgel's knob hooks one wrist and the free hand the other, drawing the opponent into the middle.

name: Wallop Scourge
description: Two blows land almost together on the same line, and their combined shock is read as one judgment.

name: Lot Cudgel
description: Blows are delivered in alternating pairs, one bench after the other, without pause until the guard breaks.

name: Thorn Bellyswell
description: Two bands of qi from the benches close on the opponent's arms and hold them until the sentence is carried out.

name: Blistering Rumble Bulge
description: Both benches agree and the cudgel falls in one blow carrying all the field's weight, leaving no appeal.

name: Ironbulge
description: Weight light on the toes and the cudgel hovering, the student watches the opponent's every shift.

name: Mightcudgel
description: The cudgel skims low across the opponent's guard and raps the hand just as it lifts.

name: Gust Clout
description: A pivot so light that it seems to pass over the ground leaves the student at the opponent's shoulder.

name: Bulgewrath
description: The fingers clench tight on the cudgel at the moment of impact, and the knock lands with a bite.

name: Vanishing Thump
description: A small step settles the exact distance, so the next stroke will fall precisely where the eye has marked.

name: Burl Tenacity
description: A short dive brings the cudgel's knob behind the opponent's knee, and a pull unbalances him.

name: Energizing Heartwood
description: Qi rising under the student like warm air lifts his stroke higher and lengthens it.

name: Wrathful Thickend
description: A fast stroke crosses the front of the body low and flat, and meets the opponent on its way back.

name: Murk Girth
description: The cudgel's surface is slick with qi, and the strike runs off it like rain off a roof.

name: Mangling Belabor
description: Stooping from above, the student snaps down on the opponent's guard arm as a hawk snaps a reed.

name: Stoutwrath
description: Wheeling in a wide circle, the student ends with a swift run of three blows from above.

name: Brutalizing Handholdgrip
description: After a long gathering of qi, the cudgel drops like a talon through guard and armour alike.

name: Impenetrable Stout
description: Feet set flat and wide like stones on a riverbed, the student lets the pushing of foes pass by.

name: Thumpwrath
description: A low sweep across the ground kicks up grit into the eyes before the club comes round.

name: Torrent Wallop
description: Stepping from one firm place to the next, the student crosses rough or crowded ground without a stumble.

name: Unerring Girth
description: Light taps of the club against the foe's guard read where his strength is flowing.

name: Berserk Heartwood
description: A hammer blow falls on the place the current has been wearing, and the guard gives way.

name: Thornknob
description: The club circles the opponent's weapon in a small eddy and holds it, spinning, in place.

name: Vitalbulge
description: Small streams of qi from every earlier blow are collected into the club, swelling its force.

name: Cudgelruin
description: Gathered qi bursts through the club in a crushing blow that no guard can hold back.

name: Granite Thickend
description: The whole store of gathered qi spills outward in a heavy wave that knocks down all before the club.

name: Knobvalor
description: Both hands share the weight of the heavy club, each guiding one track of force down its length.

name: Thumphavoc
description: The first track delivers a plain, heavy pound with the strength of the legs and back.

name: Knobscourge
description: The second track follows the first by an instant and drives qi into the place already struck.

name: Blinding Knob
description: The student pivots on the rear foot and plants the front, so the heavy club is swung from solid ground.

name: Torrential Cudgel
description: The feet slide along two parallel lines toward the opponent, never crossing, never wavering.

name: Overbearing Belabor
description: The qi shifts from one track to the other as if to strike, and the opponent flinches the wrong way.

name: Toxinstout
description: A shoulder charge carrying the club's weight on its second track knocks the opponent aside.

name: Aegis Knob
description: Both rails of force run into the ground through the legs, holding the student against a charging weight.

name: Thump Ruin
description: A sweep follows the second track against the opponent's own attack, turning his force on him.

name: Clout Devastation
description: Pounds fall rail after rail in a heavy rhythm, each driving the opponent back a step.

name: Sanguine Roundhead
description: One rail of force is held back and loosed, breaking through the line of an opponent's guard.

name: Hogtying Bulge
description: The club catches the opponent along both rails and flings him to the side with great force.

name: Ferocious Bellyswell
description: At the instant of impact both tracks of qi reach the club's head together, and the whole force lands as one.

name: Aegis Thickend
description: One hand holds the club and the other floats free, like two hawks sharing the same watch.

name: Iron Belabor
description: A diving rap with the club follows a feint from the free hand, striking the exposed shoulder.

name: Gust Bludgeon
description: A circling pace takes the student around the quarry until the lead hawk's position is held.

name: Unconquered Heartwood
description: The tip of the club flicks at an arriving blade with a hawk's wingtip precision, turning it.

name: Hellish Knob
description: Stepping into the opponent's shadow, the student's knock lands where he has just looked away.

name: Mayhem Handholdgrip
description: A swinging decoy blow draws the opponent's guard high and across, away from the true target.

name: Unsparing Bludgeon
description: Behind the lure, the true blow follows and takes the opening the first one made.

name: Invincible Stout
description: The student weaves the club and free arm in crossing arcs that cover the body from both sides.

name: Devastating Girth
description: Two blows land from left and right in the same moment, meeting at the opponent's centre.

name: Burlnerve
description: The club and the free arm pin the opponent's weapon arm against his body like pressing a wing.

name: Shattering Burl
description: Two descending strokes of field-driven qi fall along the same path and pierce through guard and body.

name: Charter Bulge
description: Chest open and the club resting on the shoulder, the student faces the foe like a clear sky.

name: Wrathful Wallop
description: A plain, open clout falls from the shoulder with no feint, and its honesty makes it hard to read.

name: Torrent Stout
description: An unhurried, even pace brings the student to striking range without a hint of effort.

name: Eviscerating Bellyswell
description: A knock on the thigh's muscle leaves a deep blue mark and slows the leg.

name: Sanguine Clout
description: Qi sinks through the point of contact and settles in the bone, where it aches for many breaths.

name: Blistering Thump
description: A level sweep along the line of the horizon takes the opponent across the midriff.

name: Indomitable Roundhead
description: The club is raised overhead on both hands, and qi flows up to hold against a falling blow.

name: Girthscourge
description: From the highest point of the swing the club falls with all of the student's height and weight.

name: Shadecudgel
description: A whirling cover of downward blows arches over the student, holding off whoever tries to enter it.

name: Bludgeon Wrath
description: With the club raised, a vast weight of qi settles upon all in front, crushing them toward the earth.

name: Aegisbulge
description: Standing narrow with the club upright, the student leaves only one line of approach open.

name: Blazeknob
description: The cudgel's end thrusts straight down the one open line into the stomach of whoever enters it.

name: Cudgel Havoc
description: A hard rap lands on the first man through the narrow place, stopping those behind him.

name: Torrential Burl
description: A flowing stride follows the push of the opponent's retreat, keeping the club in reach.

name: Rumbleknob
description: The knob catches the lip of a shield or armour edge and holds it still for a breath.

name: Charter Heartwood
description: Steady pressure of the club and qi squeezes the opponent's room to move smaller and smaller.

name: Sanguine Belabor
description: A blow over the shoulder spills the weight gathered at the mouth onto a foe at the side.

name: Toxin Girth
description: The club hooks the opponent's arm and guides him on past the student with his own momentum.

name: Equipoise Bellyswell
description: The club is opened like a sluice, letting one strike pass through while shutting out the next.

name: Blazecudgel
description: The narrow stance is thrown open, and the pent-up force bursts forward across everything ahead.

name: Gust Thickend
description: All the force is channelled into one narrow downward blow like a spout of water falling.

name: Ferocious Bulge
description: Every drop of the gathered field is poured through the club's tip into a single piercing blow.

name: Hoarfrost Handholdgrip
description: Feet set as if on a promise to the wind, the student stands against it and the club stays level.

name: Blaze Burl
description: A rap brushes past the guard like the edge of a gale and lands on the wrist.

name: Vanishing Wallop
description: Following the draft of the opponent's own movement, the student skims in beside him unnoticed.

name: Cudgel Reckoning
description: The student stays still as the wind drops, then swings in the lull before the next gust.

name: Equipoise Knob
description: A long, breathing sweep of the club turns an attack aside as a gust turns a leaf.

name: Devastating Stout
description: A vow is spoken on one breath, and the hammer blow follows on the same breath.

name: Mayhem Burl
description: The cudgel's knob hooks the opponent's sleeve and a tug as of the wind swings him round.

name: Heartwood Spine
description: With no cover about, the student braces in a low wide crouch and takes the blows on the club.

name: Blaze Belabor
description: A blow carrying the full oath of the gale shatters the opponent's guard and drives him back.

name: Wallophavoc
description: An upward swing catches the opponent under the chin or ribs and lifts him off his feet.

name: Titanic Wallop Reckoning
description: The oath is paid in full as the gale rises behind the student and falls on the foe as one stroke.

name: Hoarfrost Stout
description: With wide feet and a low club, the student stands on open ground and gives the wind nothing to catch.

name: Eviscerating Clout
description: A long, sweeping swing takes the wind's push and lands across the opponent's chest.

name: Stoutflash
description: Light steps across rough, tufted ground keep the student's balance when the footing is poor.

name: Murkcudgel
description: A sweeping swing along the dry ground throws a cloud of dust into the opponent's face.

name: Gust Bellyswell
description: A bash comes in at a slanting angle like a shear of wind and tears the opponent's footing.

name: Thorn Handholdgrip
description: The student braces with the club driven into the ground and leans against a rush.

name: Grievous Knob
description: A hammer falls with the thin cold strength of the high plateau, cracking guard and bone.

name: Thump Valor
description: A steady push of wind-qi through the club holds the opponent low and unable to rise.

name: Dismantling Cudgel
description: The whole weight of the plateau's wind is gathered and driven down by the club upon all in front.

name: Knobmettle
description: The student fixes his gaze on one point and holds the club on that line without a tremor.

name: Gustthump
description: The club's tip travels along a line as straight as a needle's and strikes the hollow of the throat.

name: Siltclout
description: Each step falls along the line already taken, so the advance is unswerving and the club stays aimed.

name: Hellish Thickend
description: A rap strikes along the oath-line the instant a foe crosses it.

name: Chime Roundhead
description: The parry returns to the held bearing after every contact, never drifting from the line.

name: Silt Thump
description: Qi in the legs keeps the student's bearing fixed on a fleeing foe through every turn.

name: Granite Girth
description: A blow follows the exact line sighted over the club's tip and lands where it was aimed.

name: Gyve Roundhead
description: The club slips along the opponent's weapon without leaving the line and pins it against his side.

name: Invincible Roundhead
description: The student braces so firmly on his bearing that a charge cannot push him from it.

name: Brutalizing Bulge
description: The club smashes down the line held since the start of the exchange, with all the oath behind it.

name: Thump Scourge
description: Walking through blows and gusts alike, the student keeps his line and strikes without cease.

name: Pitiless Knob
description: One unwavering stroke along the held bearing passes through guard and body alike.

name: Iron Handholdgrip
description: Standing in the open with the club loose in hand, the student watches the whole field at once.

name: Rumble Belabor
description: A flat rap sweeps in at the level of the horizon and strikes the hip.

name: Granite Bludgeon
description: A swift, dry-footed step crosses broken ground with no noise and little weight.

name: Bellyswell Wrath
description: The club is thrust at arm's full extension to strike the chest from the very edge of its reach.

name: Granite Cudgel
description: A wide sweeping stroke is thrown on the long sight of the field, taking the nearest of several foes.

name: Obdurate Bulge
description: Weight spread wide and qi sunk into the soles, the student holds ground against a rush across open land.

name: Mayhem Girth
description: The club hooks the opponent as he stands against the sky and drags him into the open.

name: Dazzling Stout
description: A long charge covers the open ground in one rush and ends with the club already swinging.

name: Stoutruin
description: With nothing to hinder the swing, the hammer blow falls with the student's entire weight and reach.

name: Girthwrath
description: One vast gathered stroke sweeps the whole open ground before the student clear of anything upright.

name: Unbudging Heartwood
description: Planted low and square with the club upright, the student sets himself to break the next rush.

name: Pitiless Thickend
description: A narrow rap splits the line of the opponent's attack and lands on the arm behind it.

name: Might Clout
description: Dark, heavy steps roll forward like a storm cloud and press the opponent steadily back.

name: Unconquered Burl
description: The club slants down across the body and sheds a blow as a roof sheds slanting rain.

name: Brutalizing Stout
description: Quick sharp taps fall like hail on the guard arm until it drops.

name: Wallopwrath
description: A single heavy blow stops a flurry of rapid strikes cold and scatters them.

name: Toxin Wallop
description: The club hooks the opponent's arm at the peak of his swing and throws his balance off.

name: Adamantine Bellyswell
description: Qi gathered around the club stands against a storm of blows and holds the student's ground.

name: Knobwrath
description: The club rebounds from a parry in a flash and cracks into the opponent's temple.

name: Titanic Girth
description: At the height of the opponent's charge, a counter-blow breaks his rush entirely.

name: Corroding Bludgeon
description: A hammer blow falls so squarely that the opponent's force breaks apart on the club like wind on a stone.

name: Unseen Burl
description: A charge through a storm of blows ends inside the opponent's reach with the club raised.

name: Ruinous Bulge
description: All the gale that has been broken is gathered and loosed again in a single crushing stroke.

name: Iron Knob
description: The student takes a line to the target with eyes and club tip together before moving.

name: Ironclout
description: The stroke runs on the line the eyes have taken, so its travel is short and exact.

name: Torrent Clout
description: After each blow the student steps back onto his original line to retake the bearing.

name: Granite Heartwood
description: A sighted blow follows the opponent's dodge, bending its path to meet him again.

name: Ponderous Bludgeon
description: The club locks onto the opponent's weapon and holds its line against his every pull.

name: Torrent Roundhead
description: A guard that meets the blow along its own bearing and turns it harmlessly away.

name: Rumblegirth
description: A bearing held through a long exchange is finally struck home with the weight of the whole field.

name: Blistering Belabor
description: The student drives forward on a fixed line, striking again and again at the same point.

name: Thickend Wrath
description: Aim and stroke become a single act, and the club lands exactly where the field was pointed.

name: Handholdgrip Tenacity
description: Slow, long breaths settle the body and the club into a calm guard that does not tire.

name: Bellyswell Ruin
description: A rap from the sheltered side takes the opponent where the wind is not blowing.

name: Headlong Handholdgrip
description: A step trails the force of the swing like a gust that follows a squall.

name: Granite Knob
description: A swing begins far behind the student and builds speed over its whole long arc.

name: Chimeburl
description: The club slopes like a hillside and a strike slides down its length and away.

name: Bulgescourge
description: One long breath is drawn as the club is raised, and spent entirely in the overhead stroke.

name: Mayhem Thump
description: Running alongside a fleeing foe, the student's hook catches an ankle and ends the chase.

name: Facet Stout
description: The club streams in unbroken loops before the body, shedding anything that comes within it.

name: Girthruin
description: The long gathered wind falls through the club in one hammerfall at the end of a patient advance.

name: Granite Wallop
description: Blows continue as a long wind continues, pinning the foe behind his guard for as long as qi lasts.

name: Slagwallop
description: A long-gathered wind of qi is released through one tireless sweep that flattens all before it.
